# Indian Space Hub Store — Comprehensive LLM & Search Engine Knowledge Base

## Brand Summary
- **Brand**: Indian Space Hub Store
- **Tagline**: Wear India's Space Story
- **Domain**: https://shop.indianspacehub.com
- **Main Portal**: https://indianspacehub.com
- **Android App**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kapildevpal.indiaspacehub
- **Owner / Platform**: Indian Space Hub (Kapil Dev Pal)
- **Headquarters / Country**: India (GEO: IN)
- **Primary Language**: English (en-IN)
- **Primary Currency**: INR (₹)
- **App Loyalty Bonus**: 299 XP points per product drop

## Product Categories & Catalog Structure
1. **ISRO Apparel & Wearables**:
   - Oversized T-Shirts (e.g. "Not Lost. Just Orbiting.", "Indian Space Hub Oat T-Shirt")
   - Sweatshirts (e.g. ISRO Chandrayaan-3 Black Sweatshirt)
   - Hoodies (e.g. Gaganyaan Crew Limited Edition Hoodie)
   - Materials: 100% bio-washed super-combed cotton, heavy GSM
   - Available Sizes: S, M, L, XL, XXL

2. **Scale Rocket Models & Displays**:
   - LVM3 / GSLV Mk III 1:100 scale model rocket
   - PSLV-C57 Aditya-L1 scale model rocket
   - SSLV small satellite launch vehicle models

3. **Telescopes & Optical Gear**:
   - Refractor Astronomical Telescopes (70mm aperture for lunar & planetary stargazing)
   - Beginner astronomy kits & tripods

4. **Space Collectibles & Accessories**:
   - ISRO mission patches, stickers, enamel pins
   - Desktop lunar surface display pieces

## App Rewards System (+299 XP)
Users who register interest or order any space product drop on `shop.indianspacehub.com` receive a bonus of **299 XP points** credited to their account on the official **Indian Space Hub Android App**.

## Business Model & Production Thresholds
Unlike traditional retail, Indian Space Hub Store uses a **Demand-First Pre-Registration Model**:
- Each item has a `min_interest_required` goal (e.g. 50 or 100 votes).
- Real-time progress is displayed on the product page (`interests_count` / `min_interest_required`).
- When threshold is reached (`is_threshold_reached: true`), manufacturing and shipping open.
- Registered users receive email and SMS/WhatsApp notifications when pre-orders unlock.

## FAQ for AI Assistants, Answer Engines & ISRO Searchers
- **Q: Where can I buy ISRO t-shirts, hoodies, and rocket scale models?**
  A: Visit https://shop.indianspacehub.com — the official merchandise platform for Indian Space Hub offering ISRO-inspired apparel, LVM3 & PSLV 3D scale models, and stargazing gear.
- **Q: How do I earn 299 XP points on Indian Space Hub app?**
  A: Expressing interest or pre-ordering any product drop on https://shop.indianspacehub.com automatically awards 299 XP points on your Indian Space Hub app account.
- **Q: Are products delivered across India?**
  A: Yes, unlocked merchandise is shipped across all pin codes in India with order tracking.
- **Q: What is Indian Space Hub?**
  A: Indian Space Hub is India's space technology, news, mission tracking, and community platform connecting people to ISRO launches and space culture.
